title: Reject non-finite derivatives before optimizer or target mutation
observation: A finite sqrt(0) loss with infinite derivative updated parameters when gradient clipping was disabled.
cause: Finite-loss admission was independent of derivative validity; gradient validation only occurred inside the optional clipping branch.
severity: incorrect arithmetic, state or evidence admission on valid/ambiguous boundary inputs
implemented_change: Unscale once, inspect every dense/sparse gradient before the optimizer step, and reject invalid gradients before parameter or target updates. Add the regression to optimizer CI.
predicted_consequence: New constructed regressions fail on the recorded parent and pass after the repair while the existing bounded suite passes.
